title: LUST — SIN AND DESIRE
author: Lady (Mary)
content:
I never wanted to go further than the second circle. My father told me the tower would give him power over demons — he never said it would require climbing into hell itself.

The wind here throws everything around. Souls, demons, memories. I saw my mother's face in the current three times. The third time I stopped looking.

Dante pulled me out of the second circle by my ankle. He was laughing. I shot at him on principle. He deserved it.
